sn35.17:1.1: No cedam bhikkhave cakkhussa assādo abhavissa || na yidaṃ sattā cakkhusmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn35.17:1.2: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi cakkhussa assādo tasmā sattā cakkhusmiṃ sārajjanti || || 3
sn35.17:1.3: No cedam bhikkhave cakkhussa ādīnavo abhavissa || nayidam sattā cakkhusmiṃ nibbindeyyuṃ || ||
sn35.17:1.4: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi cakkhussa ādīnavo tasmā sattā cakkhusmiṃ nibbindanti || || 4
sn35.17:1.5: No cedam bhikkhave cakkhussa nissaraṇam abhavissa || na yidaṃ sattā cakkhusmā nissareyyuṃ || ||
sn35.17:1.6: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi cakkhussa nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā cakkhusmā nissaranti || || 5-7
sn35.17:1.7: No cedam bhikkhave sotassa assādo abhavissa || 8-10
sn35.17:1.8: No cedam bhikkhave ghānassa ādīnavo abhavissa || 11
sn35.17:1.9: No cedam bhikkhave jivhāya assādo abhavissa || nayidaṃ sattā jivhāya sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn35.17:1.10: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi jivhāya assādo tasmā sattā jivhāya sārajjanti || || 12
sn35.17:1.11: No cedam bhikkhave jivhāya ādīnavo abhavissa || na yidaṃ sattā jivhāya nibbindeyyuṃ || ||
sn35.17:1.12: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi jivhāya ādīnavo tasmā sattā jivhāya nibbindanti || || 13
sn35.17:1.13: No cedam bhikkhave jivhāya nissaraṇam abhavissa || na yidam sattā jivhāya nissareyyuṃ || ||
sn35.17:1.14: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi jivhāya nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā jivhāya nissaranti || || 14-16
sn35.17:1.15: No cedam bhikkhave kāyassa assādo abhavissa || || 17
sn35.17:1.16: No cedam bhikkhave manassa assādo abhavissa || na yidaṃ sattā manasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn35.17:1.17: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi manassa assādo tasmā sattā manasmiṃ sārajjanti || || 18
sn35.17:1.18: No cedam bhikkhave manassa ādīnavo abhavissa || na yidaṃ sattā manasmiṃ nibbindeyyuṃ || ||
sn35.17:1.19: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi manassa ādīnavo tasmā sattā manasmiṃ nibbindanti || || 19
sn35.17:1.20: No cedam bhikkhave manassa nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa || nayidam sattā manasmā nissareyyuṃ ||
sn35.17:1.21: ||Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi manassa nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā manasmā nissaranti || || 20
sn35.17:2.1: Yāva kīvañca bhikkhave sattā imesaṃ channam ajjhattikānam āyatanānam assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtam nābbhaññāsuṃ || neva tāva bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vippamuttā vimariyādikatena cetasā vihariṃsu || || 21
sn35.17:2.2: Yato ca kho bhikkhave sattā imesaṃ channam ajjhattikānam āyatanānam assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato ṇissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtam abhaññāsuṃ || atha kho bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vimariyādikatena cetasā viharantīti || || 2
